permissionDescriptions.service_install_any: Allows requesting installation for services across users after backend validation.
permissionDescriptions.egg_read: Allows reading the Egg library, repository metadata and manifests.
permissionDescriptions.egg_import: Allows importing validated definitions from JSON files or repository catalogs. Imports still require approval.
permissionDescriptions.egg_manage: Allows creating Egg versions, changing availability and managing shared tags and assignments. Existing versions remain immutable. Other users' personal tags remain private.
permissionDescriptions.egg_approve: Allows approving or rejecting Egg versions. Approval does not automatically enable a version.
permissionDescriptions.egg-repository_manage: Allows registering, renaming, enabling and disabling repository sources.
permissionDescriptions.egg-repository_sync: Allows version checks and downloading repository catalogs. Importing also requires egg:import; changing automatic update settings additionally requires settings:manage.
permissionDescriptions.service_read_any: Allows administrative reading of services across users. It does not grant service management.
permissionDescriptions.service_manage_any: Allows changing service configuration, profiles, runtime versions and environment values. Stored secrets are never returned to the form. Service reading, deletion, transfer and installation have separate permissions.
permissionDescriptions.service_transfer_any: Allows transferring ownership of a service to another user.
permissionDescriptions.node_read: Allows reading node lists and details. Region and location catalogs require separate permissions.
permissionDescriptions.node_manage: Allows creating and updating nodes and rotating agent credentials. Deleting nodes requires node:delete.
permissionDescriptions.node_delete: Allows deleting nodes, subject to backend dependency checks.
permissionDescriptions.location_manage: Allows reading, creating, editing and deleting locations. Selecting a region also requires access to the region catalog.
permissionDescriptions.region_manage: Allows reading, creating, editing and deleting infrastructure regions.
permissionDescriptions.user_read: Allows reading administrative user lists and details. Role views also require role:read.
permissionDescriptions.user_create: Allows creating user accounts through the administration panel.
permissionDescriptions.user_manage: Allows changing user account data. Assigning roles requires role:assign.
permissionDescriptions.user_suspend: Authorizes user suspension in modules that support this operation.
permissionDescriptions.user_delete: Authorizes user deletion in modules that support this operation.
permissionDescriptions.role_read: Allows reading role definitions and the permission catalog. It does not allow editing or assigning roles.
permissionDescriptions.role_manage: Allows creating, editing and deleting role definitions. Owner and default role restrictions still apply. Reading requires role:read.
permissionDescriptions.role_assign: Allows assigning roles to users and revoking assignments. It does not allow editing role definitions.
permissionDescriptions.billing_read: Authorizes reading billing data in billing modules.
permissionDescriptions.billing_manage: Authorizes billing management in billing modules. Refunds have a separate permission.
permissionDescriptions.billing_refund: Authorizes refunds in billing modules that support this operation.
permissionDescriptions.plugin_read: Allows reading installed plugins, repositories and repository plugin catalogs.
permissionDescriptions.plugin_manage: Allows installing, enabling and disabling plugins. Uninstallation requires plugin:delete; repository changes require marketplace:manage.
permissionDescriptions.plugin_delete: Allows uninstalling plugins, subject to backend validation.
permissionDescriptions.marketplace_manage: Allows adding, renaming, enabling, disabling and removing community repositories. Browsing requires plugin:read.
permissionDescriptions.audit_read: Allows reading the administrative audit log.
permissionDescriptions.settings_read: Allows reading panel settings, including default role configuration.
permissionDescriptions.settings_manage: Allows changing panel settings, including the default registration role.
permissionDescriptions.backup_manage: Authorizes backup management in modules that support this operation. This global permission is separate from service member permissions.
permissionDescriptions.job_manage: Authorizes job management in modules that support this operation.
